prompts.name: vacancy_match
prompts.purpose: Explain a deterministic vacancy assessment without inventing experience.
prompts.template: Explain the assessment for {vacancy_title}. Use only these verified facts: {verified_facts}.

prompts.name: extract_vacancy_requirements
prompts.purpose: Extract atomic, source-grounded vacancy requirements without assigning a match score.
prompts.template: Extract only facts explicitly present in vacancy {vacancy_id}. Return role, seniority, responsibilities, constraints, hard_blockers, preferred_items, confidence, and atomic requirements. Every requirement must contain text, normalized_text, requirement_type, importance, weight, is_blocker, alternatives, an exact source_fragment copied from the vacancy, source_section, and confidence. Do not infer unstated requirements and do not calculate candidate suitability. Vacancy text:\n{source_text}

prompts.name: extract_candidate_evidence
prompts.purpose: Extract atomic, source-grounded candidate evidence while preserving experience strength.
prompts.template: Extract only evidence explicitly present in CV {cv_file_id} for user {user_id}. Return evidence and confidence. Every evidence item must contain text, normalized_text, evidence_type, optional skill_name, experience_level, optional years, is_verified=false, an exact source_fragment copied from the CV, optional source_section, and confidence. Distinguish production, hands_on, project, theoretical, conceptual, related, and unknown experience. Never upgrade conceptual knowledge to practical experience. CV text:\n{source_text}
